lesson: After an fp8-MoE reference is rebuilt/restored, a bit-exact 'drive the reference's own Triton kernels with a faster launch config' candidate can lose a tail-shape win because the optimal scheduling knob SHIFTS (here prefill M=4096 GROUP_SIZE_M 4->16 once the pinned-CK reference got faster), not because the candidate regressed.
